title: panicum brevifolium var. hirtifolium
intro: Panicum brevifolium var. hirtifolium, commonly known as variegated panic grass, is a type of grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of variegated panic grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
